Use legacy inline math parsing hint:
Off (default): Inline math follows Pandoc-like rules: no whitespace right after the opening $, no whitespace before the closing $, and the closing $ must not be directly followed by a digit.
On (compatible mode): Legacy Typora rule — a span from $ to the next $ counts as math if the character before the closing $ is not \\ (more dollar pairs are interpreted as math).
